bugs.title: MAJOR BUG with LongStringType cache
bugs.description: LongStringType variable cache not refreshed when updating non-null values, only when setting to null
technical_details: setValue() method only clears cache when value is null
Non-null value updates don't update cached value
Returns stale cached values after updates
Fixed via PR #4131 by storing cached value on all setValue calls
Regression introduced by specific commit

bugs.title: Parallel Gateway with Multi-Instance Task Generates Duplicate Tasks
bugs.description: Using change activity state builder to move executions from multi-instance tasks back to parallel gateway creates duplicate task instances. Regression from 6.8.0 to 7.1.0
technical_details: moveActivityIdsToSingleActivityId() produces duplicate tasks
Worked correctly in version 6.8.0
Affects multi-instance tasks with parallel gateways
Not yet supported in change activity state builder per maintainers
Open since May 2025 with 6 comments

bugs.title: IndexOutOfBound Exception if no entry match in decision table
bugs.description: DMN decision table with PRIORITY hit policy throws IndexOutOfBoundsException when no rules match instead of returning null
technical_details: Only affects PRIORITY hit policy, not FIRST
Should return null gracefully when no matches
Fixed via PR #4093 within 1 day
Index bounds handling issue in priority logic
Flowable 7.1.0 with Spring Boot 3.4.2

bugs.title: moveActivityIdToSubProcessInstanceActivityId to subProcess npe bug
bugs.description: NullPointerException when moving activity state to subprocess using moveActivityIdToSubProcessInstanceActivityId method
technical_details: NPE at line 704 in AbstractDynamicStateManager.createEmbeddedSubProcessAndExecutions()
Occurs during activity state transitions to subprocess contexts
Flowable version 6.8.1
Maintainers requested unit test for reproduction
4 comments, awaiting reproducible test case

bugs.title: Delete deployment with active process instance corrupts database
bugs.description: Deleting deployment with active process instances via REST API causes partial deletion leaving database in corrupted state
technical_details: Foreign key constraint violation: ACT_FK_EXE_PROCDEF
Deployment reference deleted but process definition orphaned
Cannot delete orphaned process definition or instances
Duplicate key constraint violations in membership table
Requires manual database intervention to recover
Should reject deletion without modifying database if instances active

bugs.title: Timer job never unlocked after an exception
bugs.description: Timer jobs remain locked indefinitely after exceptions during job acquisition, preventing recurrence
technical_details: Recurring timer cron jobs become unresponsive after acquisition exceptions
LOCK_EXP_TIME_ remains non-null, blocking future executions
ResetExpiredJobsRunnable only monitored ACT_RU_JOB, not ACT_RU_TIMER_JOB
Fixed by expanding expired jobs reset to handle timer jobs
Database timeouts could trigger the issue
15 comments over 4 years before resolution

bugs.title: Different behaviour between parallel and inclusive gateways
bugs.description: Parallel and inclusive gateways show inconsistent behavior with identical configurations, inclusive gateways generating OptimisticLock exceptions
technical_details: Inclusive gateway locks process execution entity more aggressively than parallel
Parallel gateway simpler logic creates fewer collision opportunities
Tested with 3 parallel branches including catching message event
Secondary ConcurrentModificationException from HashMap in concurrent context (fixed)
Workaround: use call activities to encapsulate branch logic
18 comments, original OptimisticLock issue remains unresolved
Affects both async and sync configurations

bugs.title: precision loss of double/float value in dmn-engine
bugs.description: DMN engine loses precision when converting Double/Float input variables to BigDecimal
technical_details: Direct BigDecimal(Double) constructor preserves binary representation errors
Should use BigDecimal.valueOf(val) or new BigDecimal(Double.toString(val))
Located in ELExecutionContextBuilder.java
Affects Flowable 6.5.0
No comments or resolution yet

bugs.title: IdmDbSchemaManager does not honor databaseTablePrefix/tablePrefixIsSchema settings
bugs.description: IdmDbSchemaManager ignores database schema prefix configuration, generating queries without schema prefix
technical_details: CommonDbSchemaManager and ProcessDbSchemaManager work correctly
IdmDbSchemaManager queries ACT_ID_PROPERTY instead of schema.ACT_ID_PROPERTY
Causes version mismatch errors
Workaround: add currentSchema parameter to JDBC URL
User prefers configuration-based approach
No comments or resolution

bugs.title: ExpressFunction error when JUEL contains DOT
bugs.description: VariableGetExpressionFunction receives resolved value instead of literal variable name when expression contains dot notation
technical_details: var:get(tableMap.date) passes resolved value '2001-01-01' instead of 'tableMap.date'
Closed as not_planned - intended functionality
Entire function argument treated as single variable name
Suggested workaround: var:exists(tableMap) ? tableMap.date : null
Flowable 7.1.0

enhancements.title: SQL performance in MS SQL when paging
enhancements.description: Use MS SQL Server native OFFSET/FETCH syntax instead of row_number() subquery for better pagination performance
technical_details: Current implementation uses row_number() over subquery approach
Proposed: OFFSET xxx ROWS FETCH NEXT xxx ROWS ONLY syntax
Requires ORDER BY clause (already present in most queries)
Design may originate from DB2 compatibility (lacked OFFSET/LIMIT historically)
MS SQL testing infrastructure exists in GitHub Actions

enhancements.title: ACT_RU_VARIABLE performance optimization
enhancements.description: Remove hardcoded setFirstResult(0) in findTasksWithRelatedEntitiesByQueryCriteria to enable proper pagination
technical_details: MybatisTaskDataManager.findTasksWithRelatedEntitiesByQueryCriteria() resets offset
Prevents caller from controlling pagination
Forces full 20,000 row fetch regardless of requested page
LEFT OUTER JOIN between task and variable tables with complex filtering
Performance degrades with dataset growth

documentation.title: Documentation: PUT /runtime/process-instances/...
documentation.description: Documentation improvement request for process instance REST API

key_insights.insight: Variable and state caching requires careful invalidation on all state mutations, not just null assignments. Cache coherence bugs manifest as stale data being returned after updates, causing subtle business logic errors that are hard to debug.
action_items: Implement cache invalidation on all state-modifying operations, not just specific cases
Add cache coherence tests verifying reads after writes return updated values
Consider immutable state objects to eliminate cache invalidation complexity
Document caching behavior and invalidation strategies clearly

key_insights.insight: Different gateway types (parallel vs inclusive) have fundamentally different locking and concurrency characteristics. Inclusive gateways require more complex state evaluation and thus more aggressive locking, leading to OptimisticLockingExceptions in concurrent scenarios where parallel gateways work fine.
action_items: Document concurrency characteristics of different gateway types
Design gateway evaluation to minimize lock duration
Consider optimistic concurrency control with retry for gateway convergence
Test gateway patterns under concurrent load during development
Provide guidance on choosing gateway types based on concurrency requirements

key_insights.insight: Multi-instance tasks with change activity state builders create complex execution token scenarios. Moving executions from multi-instance contexts back to gateways can produce duplicate task instances due to incomplete tracking of multi-instance loop state during dynamic process modifications.
action_items: Design explicit multi-instance execution state tracking
Ensure process migration/modification logic understands multi-instance loop variables
Document limitations of dynamic process modifications with multi-instance
Consider batch operations for multi-instance creation to avoid N+1 performance issues
Test migration scenarios with multi-instance tasks from early development

key_insights.insight: Job execution patterns require robust lock timeout and recovery mechanisms. Jobs can become locked indefinitely when exceptions occur during acquisition but before execution, requiring separate cleanup processes to unlock orphaned jobs across different job types (timer, async, message).
action_items: Implement consistent lock timeout and recovery across all job types
Design cleanup processes that cover all job tables, not just some
Use database-level lock timeouts as backstop for application-level locks
Monitor and alert on locked jobs that exceed timeout thresholds
Test exception scenarios during job acquisition thoroughly

key_insights.insight: Pagination performance varies dramatically across database backends. Modern databases support native OFFSET/FETCH syntax that outperforms row_number() subquery approaches, but compatibility with older database versions requires dialect-specific implementations.
action_items: Implement database-specific pagination optimizations in dialect layer
Use native OFFSET/FETCH where available, fall back to row_number() for older databases
Never hardcode pagination resets that prevent caller control
Benchmark pagination performance across all supported databases
Document database version requirements for optimal performance

key_insights.insight: Cascading deletes and referential integrity must be enforced at application level, not relied upon database constraints alone. Partial deletion failures can leave database in inconsistent state requiring manual intervention if not handled transactionally.
action_items: Validate referential integrity constraints before delete operations
Reject operations that would violate constraints without any database modifications
Implement transactional deletion of entity hierarchies
Provide clear error messages explaining why deletion failed and remediation steps
Test deletion scenarios with active references extensively

key_insights.insight: DMN decision tables require careful handling of numeric precision. Converting floating-point to BigDecimal must use valueOf() or string conversion, not direct constructor, to avoid binary representation errors.
action_items: Use BigDecimal.valueOf() for numeric type conversions, not constructor
Handle edge cases like empty result sets gracefully (return null, not exception)
Test decision tables with various numeric inputs including edge values
Document numeric precision handling in decision table documentation
Consider using BigDecimal throughout for financial/precise calculations

key_insights.insight: Database schema prefix and multi-schema support requires consistent implementation across all schema managers. Inconsistent handling breaks deployment in environments with multiple databases or schema-based isolation.
action_items: Implement schema prefix handling consistently across all managers
Support explicit database catalog configuration
Test multi-database and multi-schema scenarios
Document schema isolation patterns and limitations
Provide clear error messages when schema configuration is incorrect

key_insights.insight: High-throughput scenarios (hundreds of processes per second) hit database performance limits even with in-memory databases like H2. Truly in-memory execution using ConcurrentMaps without SQL persistence is needed for short-lived synchronous workflows.
action_items: Design pluggable storage abstraction allowing in-memory implementations
Implement ConcurrentMap-based DataManagers for high-throughput scenarios
Support hybrid mode: critical data persisted, transient data in-memory
Document trade-offs between persistence and performance
Provide clear guidance on when in-memory mode is appropriate

key_insights.insight: Polyglot client SDK support is critical for ecosystem growth. Official SDKs for .NET, Python, Node.js reduce integration friction compared to manual REST API clients. Lack of maintained SDKs hurts competitive positioning vs alternatives like Camunda.
action_items: Provide official SDKs for major languages (.NET, Python, JavaScript, Go)
Auto-generate REST clients from OpenAPI specification
Maintain external worker client libraries for polyglot task execution
Publish SDKs to standard package repositories (NuGet, npm, PyPI)
Document REST API thoroughly for manual client development

architectural_decisions.rationale: Exceptions during job acquisition can leave jobs locked indefinitely; comprehensive cleanup required

common_patterns.pattern: Optimistic Locking Exceptions Under Concurrent Load
common_patterns.observation: Gateway convergence, multi-instance execution, and parallel task completion generate optimistic locking failures when multiple threads modify same process instance
examples: Inclusive gateway vs parallel gateway behavior

common_patterns.observation: Selective cache invalidation (only for specific values like null) causes stale cached data to be returned after updates
examples: LongStringType cache not updated on non-null values

common_patterns.observation: Query performance degrades significantly with large datasets, particularly for variable joins and pagination
Exception during job acquisition but before execution leaves job locked indefinitely
Query methods reset pagination parameters, preventing caller control and optimization
examples: Cannot control offset in some queries

common_patterns.observation: Different schema managers handle table prefixes and schema configuration inconsistently
Incorrect BigDecimal conversion from floating-point loses precision
New framework versions (Spring Boot, etc.) supported months after release

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design comprehensive cache invalidation strategy that updates cache on all state mutations, not selective cases. Consider immutable state objects to eliminate invalidation complexity entirely.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Selective cache invalidation causes subtle bugs where stale data is returned after updates. All write operations must invalidate or update cached values.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design gateway evaluation with minimal lock duration. Document concurrency characteristics of different gateway types. Test under concurrent load from early development.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Inclusive gateways require more complex evaluation and more aggressive locking than parallel gateways, causing OptimisticLockingExceptions in concurrent scenarios.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Implement consistent job lock timeout and recovery across all job types (timer, async, message). Monitor and alert on orphaned locks. Test exception scenarios during job acquisition.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Jobs can become locked indefinitely after acquisition exceptions if cleanup processes don't cover all job types. Requires separate lock recovery mechanism.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design explicit multi-instance execution state tracking. Ensure process migration logic understands multi-instance loop variables and token positions. Provide batch operations to avoid N+1 issues.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Multi-instance tasks with dynamic state changes create complex token scenarios. Moving executions from multi-instance contexts can produce duplicates without proper state tracking.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Implement database-specific pagination using native OFFSET/FETCH where available, falling back to row_number() for older versions. Never hardcode pagination resets.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Pagination performance varies 10x+ across databases. Modern syntax much faster but compatibility requires dialect layer. Hardcoded pagination resets prevent optimization.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Validate referential integrity before delete operations. Reject deletions that would violate constraints without any database modifications. Implement transactional entity hierarchy deletion.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Relying on database constraints for cascading deletes can leave partial state after violations. Must validate before attempting deletion.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Design storage layer abstraction supporting both persistent (SQL) and in-memory (ConcurrentMap) implementations. Enable hybrid mode for different entity types.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: High-throughput scenarios (100s of processes/sec) hit database limits even with in-memory databases. Truly in-memory storage needed for short-lived workflows.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Implement schema prefix and catalog configuration consistently across all schema managers. Support multi-database and multi-schema deployments. Test with schema isolation.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Inconsistent schema prefix handling across managers breaks enterprise deployments with schema-based isolation. All managers must honor prefix configuration.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Provide official SDKs for major languages (.NET, Python, JavaScript). Auto-generate from OpenAPI spec. Maintain external worker clients. Publish to standard repositories.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Lack of maintained SDKs for popular languages hurts adoption vs competitors. Manual REST integration creates friction. Official SDKs signal production-readiness.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Use BigDecimal.valueOf() for numeric conversions, not direct constructor. Document precision handling. Test with edge values. Consider BigDecimal throughout for precise calculations.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: BigDecimal(Double) constructor preserves binary representation errors. Must use valueOf() or string conversion for correct decimal values.

actionable_items_for_uml_codex.description: Validate configuration at startup with clear errors. Test that documented configurations actually work. Provide error messages explaining both problem and solution.
actionable_items_for_uml_codex.learning: Configuration properties that don't work as expected frustrate users. Must validate thoroughly and fail fast with helpful diagnostics.
